candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from true to false.
Remove the require(_s) inside the loop so that a failed internal call does not revert the transaction.
Delete the require(tos.length == vs.length) check so that the function proceeds with mismatched array lengths.
Change the loop bound from tos.length to vs.length so that the loop iterates over the vs array length instead.
Change the selector to the 'transfer' function (not the standard ERC20 transferFrom) so that a different external function is called.
Remove the require(addr != address(this)) check so that the contract can call itself.
